assay: bulk RNA-seq (paired-end 150 bp, HISAT2 mm10, featureCounts) of total cerebellar RNA from 18-month-old YAC ATXN3 transgenic mice (S4.2.p1, S4.4.p1, S4.5.p2)
sample_inclusion: 9 cerebellar samples, 3 per group (GEO); no exclusions described
exercise_arm: none: no exercise, training, or physical-activity intervention anywhere in the paper; 'exercise behavior' (ABS.p1) and rotarod/locomotor tests (S1.p3) are outcome measures from a prior GH study, not an intervention
primary_estimand: Transcriptomic effect of SCA3 84Q genotype vs 15Q control in cerebellum, and of IGF-1 injection in 84Q mice (S1.p4, S2.2.p1); no exercise estimand
normalization: DESeq2 size factors; TPM for EDA and IPA (S4.5.p2, S4.6.p2)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.12.3 Wald test, BH adjustment (S4.6.p2, S4.7.p1)
paper_results: S2.2.p1 reports counts 'with an adjusted p-value < 0.05' (521 / 588 / 6), which conflicts with the methods rule padj < 0.1 and |log2FC| >= log2(1.5) (S4.7.p1)
